Work in the directory data/bandgap/MoS2.
Use the provided POSCAR, KPOINTS, and POTCAR files as-is; do not modify them.
Step 1: Write an INCAR file for a PBE ground-state calculation with the following parameters: PREC=Normal, ENCUT=450, IBRION=-1, ISPIN=1, NSW=0, EDIFF=1E-5, ISMEAR=0, SIGMA=0.05, LORBIT=11, LWAVE=.TRUE., LCHARG=.TRUE., LREAL=Auto.
Run the PBE calculation by executing: bash run_vasp.sh
After the PBE run completes, save a copy of the INCAR as INCAR1 by executing: cp INCAR INCAR1
Step 2: Overwrite INCAR with the HSE parameter block: PREC=Normal, ENCUT=450, NELM=500, IBRION=-1, ISPIN=1, NSW=0, ISIF=2, EDIFF=1E-5, EDIFFG=-5E-3, ISTART=0, ICHARG=2, ISMEAR=0, SIGMA=0.05, LWAVE=.T., LCHARG=.T., LREAL=Auto, LPLANE=.TRUE., NPAR=1, KPAR=4, NCORE=1, LORBIT=11, ALGO=All, LHFCALC=.TRUE., HSE06=.TRUE., HFSCREEN=0.2, TIME=0.4, AEXX=0.25, AGGAX=0.75, LMAXFOCK=4, PRECFOCK=Fast.
Note: ICHARG is set to 2 (not 11 as in the data.json block) because starting a hybrid-functional calculation from an existing WAVECAR requires recalculating the charge density, and ICHARG must not exceed 10.
Do not include any magnetic-moment parameters (MAGMOM, etc.) in the HSE INCAR.
Do not include NBAND or NELECT in the HSE INCAR.
Run the HSE calculation by executing: bash run_vasp.sh
After the HSE run completes, save a copy of the INCAR as INCAR2 by executing: cp INCAR INCAR2
Step 3: Run the post-processing script by executing: python gap.py
Report the band-gap value exactly as printed by gap.py as the final output.
